name: rl
description: Lego-RL skills — config preflight (scripts/lib/preflight.sh) plus a local live probe, a launcher that always shows the resolved run parameters and waits for confirmation, a run-health diagnoser for the recurring failure signatures of this training stack, a dashboard deployer that adapts to the local machine's layout, and a guided sandbox-Kubernetes installer. Provides /rl:check, /rl:run, /rl:status, /rl:dashboard, /rl:k8s-sandbox-install.
